page.notes: Hebrew words are small and partly unclear; the forms written here are my best reading and should be checked against the scan, especially the first Hebrew word after "ne" and the pointed forms. "alii" after the second dictio carries a superscript mark, rendered as <sup>1</sup>. Small printed marks (star before "&c.", dots in the text) are not transcribed as text. The word "dvod" is possibly a misprint for "quod".
